title: Diagonal card staircase loop
summary: One hero image card shrinks into a pile of five, the pile fans out into a corner-to-corner diagonal and the view steps one card per second, then the cards slide back into one pile and the hero grows to fill the frame again: a seamless loop.
use_when: Showing four or five product shots, icons or renders as one calm sequence
A square feed loop for a minimal dev tool or SaaS brand
A gallery of feature visuals where each needs about one second of focus
Silent autoplay where no copy is needed beyond a small label block

look.type_style: small uppercase grotesk label block, regular weight, normal tracking, about 1.2 % H per line, white, fixed at the left edge

sfx.event: the pile fans out behind the hero card
each staircase step settles on the next card
the hero card lands full size at the loop seam

structure.shot: one light grey square image card, 0.77 W, centred on black; small 5-line label block at the left edge
same card shrunk on top of a pile of five square cards fanned down-right in a diagonal staircase
structure.camera: drift: pile moves up-left, about 0.05 W over 1.0 s
structure.motion: hero 0.65 W -> 0.42 W by 0.77, easings.outExpo 8 fr (±0.25 s); pile offset grows 0.07 W -> 0.09 W per card, easings.linear

structure.shot: staircase spread corner to corner at 0.42 W per card: card 2 (dark UI panel) in focus, card 1 exiting top-left, card 3 bottom-right
structure.camera: dolly down-right one card (0.42 W, 0.42 H) then hold; slow push 1.00 -> 1.05
structure.motion: spread from pile to corner-to-corner offset in <= 8 fr (±0.25 s), easings.inOutCubic; hold about 22 fr

structure.shot: card 3 (phone-like UI with tab bar) in focus; card 2 top-left, card 4 bottom-right
structure.camera: dolly down-right one card step, then hold
structure.motion: step move <= 8 fr (±0.25 s), easings.inOutCubic; hold about 22 fr

structure.shot: card 4 (dark capsule object on a plinth) in focus; earlier cards now overlap in the top-left corner
structure.camera: dolly down-right one card step, then hold
structure.motion: step move <= 8 fr (±0.25 s), easings.inOutCubic; passed cards stack at 0.07 W offsets in the corner

structure.shot: card 5 (dark ring object on mid grey) in focus, last card, nothing to its lower right
structure.camera: dolly down-right one card step, then hold
structure.motion: step move <= 8 fr (±0.25 s), easings.inOutCubic; hold about 22 fr

structure.shot: cards slide back up-left onto each other; by 6.27 one compact pile, card 1 on top, 0.34 W, centred
structure.camera: pull back: content scale -3 %/s, framing recentres on the pile
structure.motion: collapse in reverse order, 1 s total, easings.inOutCubic (±0.25 s); pile offset 0.09 W -> 0.01 W

structure.shot: top card grows from 0.35 W back to the 0.77 W hero, identical to frame 0, then holds
structure.motion: scale 0.35 W -> 0.71 W in 7 fr (6.47-6.70), settles 0.77 W by 7.00, springs.cameraIn (overshoot not measurable); hold 30 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the frame, surface for card fills, mono or text font for the label block
params.content.cards: 4-6 square images (renders, icons, UI crops), shown in order; the first is the hero and the loop seam
params.content.label: up to 4 short label lines plus the brand mark, fixed at the left edge
params.aspect: 1:1 by default; 4:5 and 9:16 keep the 45 degree diagonal and scale card size to width
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). Hero 0.77 W, stack and staircase cards 0.42 W, final pile 0.34 W. Pile offset 0.07-0.09 W; staircase offset = one card width (corners touch). One step per 1.0 s. Last frame equals frame 0: loop. No audio in the reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): staircase-dolly, stack-collapse.
